generation_mode: Built-in image_gen exclusively. No API or CLI fallback.
scope: New art and provenance only. No renderer, UI, tests, Han knee assets, commits or deployment were changed by this worker.
conversion: ImageMagick lossless WebP encoding. Ma heads were resized to 512x512. Atlases retain native 1536x1024. No programmatic anatomy editing, mirroring, painting, masking or compositing.
handedness_convention: Subject's own anatomical side. Upright palm facing viewer: right hand thumb is image-right; left hand thumb is image-left. Upright dorsal right hand: thumb is image-left.
